The club pledged to invest 10% of all partnership revenue into programmes that strengthen the city. Introduced in 2021, before Patrick joined the ownership group in 2023, the initiative has supported youth sports, local organisations and opportunities for women and girls across Kansas City.

title: As Florida uses robot rabbits to catch pythons; study reveals when snakes climb trees
description: In 2025, Florida implemented solar-powered robotic rabbit decoys designed to attract Burmese pythons for removal efforts. Researchers tracked 346 pythons from 2017 to 2024 to study their climbing behavior. The study found that juvenile pythons are more likely to climb trees compared to adults. A recent competition in 2026 resulted in 280 pythons being removed by participants. Since 2017, over 19,000 pythons have been captured in Florida through organized efforts.

title: Travis Kelce’s mother Donna opens up about living alone and life away from her sons
description: Donna Kelce has opened up about living alone in Florida while her sons, Jason and Travis, manage demanding careers and busy personal lives. In an interview with Architectural Digest, she admitted she sometimes has no idea which city they are visiting. Despite the distance, Donna says her sons are always on her mind. She fills her days with simple routines and photographs that remind her of family memories.
